turns.text: Hi everybody, thanks for coming. Um, my name is Sam Gair, I'm the Chief Investment Officer at Monarch Asset Management. Monarch runs three core strategies: market neutral dollar, market neutral Bitcoin, and directional strategy, which I am fortunately—or unfortunately—in charge of in a market that has no direction. So, before Monarch, I was at, um, I was at Block Tower, and prior to that I had my own hedge fund called Katana Financial, which is how I got into crypto. We were one of the largest VIX traders on the platform, about 10% of daily VIX volume. And just through my knowledge of the exchange space, I got really interested in crypto, and we became one of the first market makers on the CME products, on the CME platform. Prior to that, I held two pretty notable positions in the industry. I was the Chief Information Officer at FINRA for a couple of years, which was fun, and I was also the Chief Information Officer and eventually the EVP COO of NYMEX, New York Mercantile Exchange, largest energy exchange in the world, which did a $9 billion merger with CME. I started trading in the pits, so if you see my hands waving around, that's probably why.
turns.roleAtRecording: Chief Investment Officer at Monarq Asset Management

turns.text: Great. Good morning. I'm Duncan, president at 21Shares. We are now Europe's largest crypto asset manager. We have about $7 billion globally: U.S., Europe, Australia, Brazil. And, look, we began to bridge—be the bridge—between crypto, DeFi, and TradFi. It started with ETPs and ETFs, now expanded to structured products, active strategies, and venture and other things to come. So, very happy to be here, and I look forward to the discussion.

turns.text: Yeah, and I'm David Kanitsky, Chief Corporate Development Officer at EverStake. EverStake is one of the largest non-custodial staking providers in the industry. I've been in crypto way too long, for like 14 years maybe now. I helped build Grayscale and ran it for the first couple of years of its existence, before becoming Fidelity's first crypto hire, and then more recently was at Circle and Crack it before joining EverStake last year, in part because I was pretty excited about the on-chain yield kind of cycle to come.

They no longer compete in—from several years ago we had a zero interest rate environment, and from a yield perspective they were very attractive when you have 8, 10, 12 percent yields. turns.roleAtRecording: Chief Investment Officer at Monarq Asset Management

turns.text: Yeah, sure. So, I think that's correct. So, you get this kind of like baby steps,right? So, that's kind of like where we are now.
